acceptance_gates.active_mode_absolute_frequency_gate_appl: apply separately to nominal complete and to each numerical variant only when that history's engineering damping ratio exceeds the activation threshold
acceptance_gates.active_mode_intervariant_frequency_gate_: apply only when the same reviewed mode exceeds the activation threshold in both nominal-complete and numerical-variant histories; otherwise report the exact non-applicability reason

analysis_contract.finite_record_del_normalization: damage divided by physical record duration before applying the inverse Wohler exponent
analysis_contract.modal_frequency_interpretation: dominant frequency of filtered modal velocity; active classification must be unchanged between nominal and each numerical variant, absolute-band gates apply separately to each active history, and the intervariant gate applies only when both histories exceed an engineering aerodynamic-to-structural damping ratio of 1.0; internal consistency diagnostic, not physical lock-in validation
analysis_contract.quantity: selected local blade moment at r/R=0.23
analysis_contract.response_off_interpretation: dynamical response-work ablation within the complete residual partition; effect magnitude is reported without a closeness gate and is not pointwise force subtraction or isolated negative-damping validation
analysis_contract.ratio_interpretation: raw and one-way sensitivity denominators are not rerun; resulting ratios are diagnostic contextual numerator sensitivities, not independent gates or matched three-path numerical convergence

claim_boundary: Two prespecified U35 engineering-screening rows and their selected local blade-moment channels at r/R=0.23 only. The package does not establish full timestep convergence, bandwidth independence, a resolved wind-distribution fatigue integral, H-VAWT physical validation, fatigue life, ultimate loads, governing structural loads, or certification loads. The 10% DEL screen is not an uncertainty bound and, for m=10, corresponds to about 2.59 times the underlying range-power sum.

lower_cap_basis.statement: Predeclared numerical bandwidth diagnostic at one-half nominal Nyquist; not a validated physical cutoff.
